result.keyword: What are the best managed SOC providers in India?

items.markdown:
When selecting a Managed Security Operations Center (MSOC / Managed SOC) provider in India, the right choice depends on your organization's size, compliance requirements (such as `DPDPA, RBI/SEBI guidelines, or CERT-In directives), and infrastructure complexity`.

The top-performing providers operating in India are categorized below by their primary strengths:

#### 1. Large-Scale Enterprise & Global IT Leaders

- Tata Consultancy Services[Tata Consultancy Services](https://www.tcs.com/) ** (TCS):** Offers massive, global-scale security operations, managed detection and response (MDR), and continuous risk monitoring. Ideal for large enterprises with multi-region footprints and heavy regulatory workloads Embee.[[1]](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/)
- Wipro[Wipro](https://www.wipro.com/applications/managed-services/) **:** Delivers integrated cybersecurity, risk management, and 24/7 managed security services through specialized cyber-defense centers, tailored for large enterprise estates Embee[Embee](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/).[[1]](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/)
- Infosys[Infosys](https://www.infosys.com/) **:** Features broad cybersecurity services backed by heavy AI, machine learning, and automation, supported by one of the largest dedicated security workforces in India Embee.[[1]](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/)
- HCLTech[HCLTech](https://www.hcltech.com/) **:** Known for enterprise security operations, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), and deep infrastructure-level threat management Embee.[[1]](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/)
- Tech Mahindra[Tech Mahindra](https://www.techmahindra.com/) **:** Specializes in hybrid-cloud security, threat validation, SASE/Cisco architectures, and policy alignment (ISO 27001, DPDPA) [Tech Mahindra](https://www.techmahindra.com/insights/press-releases/techmahindra-q1-fy24-results/).

#### 2. Specialized & Regional Security Specialists

- Inspira Enterprise[Inspira Enterprise](https://inspiraenterprise.com/) **:** Widely recognized for security intelligence operations centers (SIOC) and managed detection and response (MDR) tailored heavily for BFSI, government, and scaling mid-sized businesses Factosecure.
- SISA Information Security[SISA Information Security](https://sisa.ai/) **:** A prominent name in financial cybersecurity, payments, and compliance-driven SOC services (PCI-DSS, banking regulations) Factosecure.
- CyberNX Technologies[CyberNX Technologies](https://www.cybernx.com/) **:** A CERT-In empanelled provider trusted by startups and enterprises needing rapid incident response and robust threat detection Factosecure.
- Seqrite[Seqrite](https://www.seqrite.com/) ** (Quick Heal):** Offers cost-effective, India-centric endpoint and network-integrated SOC solutions ideal for budget-conscious organizations and growing businesses Factosecure.[[1]](https://factosecure.com/top-5-soc-service-providers-in-india-for-startups-2026/)[[2]](https://embee.co.in/blog/custom-cybersecurity-solutions-providers-india/)

#### Key Factors to Evaluate

- **Compliance Alignment:** Ensure the provider handles local Indian mandates (such as **CERT-In** reporting timelines and the **Digital Personal Data Protection Act - DPDPA** ) alongside global standards like ISO 27001 or SOC 2.
- **Onboarding & Visibility:** Check whether they offer a "bring-your-own-tool" model (wrapping around your existing Microsoft, CrowdStrike, or Splunk stack) or require a full-platform rip-and-replace.
- **Mean Time to Respond (MTTR):** Look for SLAs that promise rapid triage and active containment (ideally under 15–30 minutes for critical alerts).

If you share your **company size**, **industry** (e.g., BFSI, SaaS, healthcare), or **current tech stack** (Microsoft, AWS, CrowdStrike), I can help you **narrow down the best-fit provider**.
